exposure: transvaginal ultrasound anomaly scan during the early second trimester
cohort: 164 women who underwent a transvaginal ultrasound and 224 women who underwent a transabdominal ultrasound at 14-17 weeks gestation
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound anomaly scan conducted in the early second trimester of pregnancy is a safe procedure for the fetus.
mod_finding: While the transvaginal scan group had more operative deliveries overall, transvaginal ultrasound anomaly scans were not significantly associated with increased rates of operative delivery.
